messages.subject: Error in sampler$call_sampler(c(args, dotlist))
parts:
Hello, thank you, as always.
I am a biginner at stan.I want to use ADVI , but I have this eroor.
I do with RStan:  vb(model0,data)
When I use "sampling(model,data)" , the error dont happen.


Begin eta adaptation.
Iteration:   1 / 250 [  0%]  (Adaptation)
Iteration:  50 / 250 [ 20%]  (Adaptation)
Iteration: 100 / 250 [ 40%]  (Adaptation)
Iteration: 150 / 250 [ 60%]  (Adaptation)
Iteration: 200 / 250 [ 80%]  (Adaptation)
Iteration: 250 / 250 [100%]  (Adaptation)
Success! Found best value [eta = 0.1].

Begin stochastic gradient ascent.
  iter       ELBO   delta_ELBO_mean   delta_ELBO_med   notes 
   100    -2e+006             1.000            1.000
Error in sampler$call_sampler(c(args, dotlist)) : 
  stan::variational::advi::calc_ELBO: The number of dropped evaluations has reached its maximum amount (100). Your model may be either severely ill-conditioned or misspecified.

Please tell me to solve this.
Thank you.

I use this stan code.
data{
int<lower=1> S;      # num section
int<lower=1> K;      # num topics
int<lower=1> D;      # num document
int<lower=1> V;      # num word
int<lower=1> N;      # total word instances
int<lower=1,upper=V> W[N] ;  # word n
int<lower=1, upper=31000> Offset[D,2];  # range of word
vector<lower=0>[K] Alpha[S];          # topic prior
vector<lower=0>[V] Beta;           # word prior
vector<lower=0>[S] Delta;          # section prior
vector<lower=0>[S] EPU0;
simplex[K] Zeta0[S];
simplex[V] Xi0[K];
}
parameters {
simplex[S] MU[D];
vector<lower=0,upper=5>[S] EPU;
simplex[K] THETA[D,S];
simplex[V] PHI[K];
}
model {
# prior
  EPU ~ gamma(Delta .* EPU0,Delta);
    for (d in 1:D){
    MU[d] ~ dirichlet(EPU);
    #print("MU=",MU)
   for(s in 1:S)
     THETA[d,s] ~ dirichlet(Alpha[s] .* Zeta0[s]);
   }
  for (k in 1:K)
    PHI[k] ~ dirichlet(Beta .* Xi0[k]);
# likelihood
  for (d in 1:D) {
    for (n in Offset[d,1]:Offset[d,2]) {
      real lp_s[S];
      for (s in 1:S){
        real lp[K];
        for (k in 1:K)
          lp[k] = log(THETA[d,s,k]) + log(PHI[k,W[n]]);
        lp_s[s] = log(MU[d,s]) + log_sum_exp(lp);
      }
      target += log_sum_exp(lp_s); 
    }
  }
}

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error in sampler$call_sampler(c(args, dotlist))
parts:
If the problem doesn't get better after increasing adapt_delta,
you'll need to reparameterize.

That might help with ADVI, too. Andrew's been looking at
some cases where ADVI fails for one parameterization but not
the other.

- Bob

Which simpler models have you fit successfully? If none,
I would strongly urge you to start with something simple and
work up to this model as you understand Stan better.

It's very hard to just debug a model with a graphical model
diagram and Stan code without a lot of effort, and we're
a bit overwhelmed by all the mail to the list these days.

- Bob
